dz: 当阿罕布拉法令生效时，所有剩余的犹太人都将被驱逐出西班牙。

dz: 雅克·库尔被法国查理七世下令逮捕.

de: Hundred Years' War: Battle of Cravant: A Franco-Scottish army is defeated by the Anglo-Burgundians at Cravant on the banks of the river Yonne.

te: Pope Sergius IV becomes the 142nd pope, succeeding Pope John XVIII.
dz: 教皇塞尔吉乌斯四世成为第 142 任教皇，接替教皇约翰十八世。

de: The oldest recorded eruption of Mount Fuji (Traditional Japanese date: Sixth day of the seventh month of the first year of the Ten'o (天応) era).

dz: 在塞拉斯蒂内一世教皇去世后的四天前选举出六多斯三世为教皇.
